Image 2 is the identity and costume reference for 虚人梦: long gold blond locks, red eyes, crimson hood, dark outfit and exactly one ivory mask clasped to his anatomical left shoulder (viewer-right in a frontal view). His own face and hooded eyes stay visible. Both references supply appearance. Style: polished cinematic 3D animation still with anime facial design, sculpted fabric, readable expression and filmic contrast. Set the existing two-character face-off in the movie's dim wood-panelled room. Use a broken wall opening and a hint of the faded red chair in the softened background. Restrained cold blue shadow and warm crimson/amber light, strong clear face lighting, sparse warm flecks. Keep both characters dignified and equally prominent. No weapons, muzzle flashes, violence, gore, instruments, platform logos, badges, borders, credits, extra figures, or watermark. Design two lines of actual integrated simplified Chinese display typography. Exact main line: “琵琶曲” (琵, 琶, 曲). Exact small line: “神隐黑炎 VS 虚人梦”. Use perfectly legible compact bold Song-style lettering for the main line, warm ivory, and a clear smaller ivory subtitle. No quote marks and no other text. Keep all words well away from the edges, high contrast, sharp and readable on a mobile thumbnail. Keep the artwork and typography composed in the central safe area.

Put the title and matchup on two centered lines over the dark lower foreground, with the title near 73% of image height and the subtitle near 86%.
